links.outcome: Effect of echocardiographic image quality on ML measurement performance
links.effect: Poor-quality images reduced ML diagnostic yield; image quality significantly influenced performance. RA and RV agreement was moderate, worse under stress.
links.quote: Image quality significantly influenced ML performance, as poor-quality images reduced diagnostic yield.

screen.reason: Retrospective multicenter external validation evaluating an automated machine learning tool against expert cardiologist manual tracings on stress echocardiography images without testing specific deployment safeguards.
